mapper.sql: id, title, file_type, file_size, file_id, content_hash, visibility, owner_dept_id, status, parse_message, chunk_count, created_by, created_at
LEFT JOIN org_department d ON d.id = doc.owner_dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = doc.created_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_document (title, file_type, file_size, file_id, content_hash, visibility, owner_dept_id, status, parse_message, chunk_count, created_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{fileId}, #{contentHash}, #{visibility}, #{ownerDeptId}, #{status}, #{parseMessage}, #{chunkCount}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select:
SELECT doc.id, doc.title, doc.file_type AS fileType, doc.file_size AS fileSize, doc.file_id AS fileId, doc.content_hash AS contentHash, doc.visibility, doc.owner_dept_id AS ownerDeptId, doc.status, doc.parse_message AS parseMessage, doc.chunk_count AS chunkCount, doc.created_by AS createdBy, doc.created_at AS createdAt, d.dept_name AS ownerDeptName, u.nickname AS createdByName FROM kb_document doc
WHERE doc.id = #{id}

SELECT doc.id, doc.title, doc.file_type AS fileType, doc.file_size AS fileSize, doc.file_id AS fileId, doc.content_hash AS contentHash, doc.visibility, doc.owner_dept_id AS ownerDeptId, doc.status, doc.parse_message AS parseMessage, doc.chunk_count AS chunkCount, doc.created_by AS createdBy, doc.created_at AS createdAt, d.dept_name AS ownerDeptName, u.nickname AS createdByName FROM kb_document doc
ORDER BY doc.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
